name: Rule of thirds
definition: Two horizontal and two vertical lines divide the view into nine equal parts. The focal point sits on one of the four crossings, and a horizon sits on one of the two horizontal lines.

sources.title: John Thomas Smith, Remarks on Rural Scenery (1797), the first printed use of the term
Rudolf Arnheim, Art and Visual Perception: A Psychology of the Creative Eye (University of California Press, 1954; new version 1974)
